title: RadioButton
description: A radio button component with RadioButton and RadioGroup for single-selection within a group.

defaultValue.description: Initial selected value for uncontrolled usage.

onValueChange.description: (value: string) => void - Fires when the selected value changes.

onFocus.description: (event: FocusEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => void - Fires when a radio receives focus.

onBlur.description: (event: FocusEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => void - Fires when a radio loses focus.

label.description: React.ReactNode - Text label for the group.

description.description: React.ReactNode - Helper text for the group.

disabled.description: Disables all radio buttons in the group.

error.description: Displays the group in an error state.

errorMessage.description: React.ReactNode - Error message displayed below the group.

success.description: Displays the group in a success state.

successMessage.description: React.ReactNode - Success message displayed below the group.

classes.description: CSS class overrides for group sub-elements.

reduceMotion.description: Controls motion preferences. 'auto' respects the user's OS setting.

className.description: Additional class names applied to the group root.

oneOf.description: Props for an individual RadioButton within a RadioGroup.

checkedIcon.description: React.ReactNode - Custom icon for the checked state.
